vectors.threat: Anonymous inbox readers can enumerate relationship requests.
vectors.expected: The public authorization grants Append only and never Read, Write, or Control.
vectors.testName: grants public append without public read, write, or control for the social inbox

vectors.threat: An attacker fills an append-only inbox beyond the bounded processing budget.
vectors.expected: Container bytes are stream-bounded and each sync returns a drainable direct-child batch instead of denying all processing.
vectors.testName: returns a bounded drainable batch when the inbox exceeds the processing limit

vectors.threat: A transient Pod or verification failure causes a valid appended request to be silently discarded.
vectors.expected: Failed reads remain in the inbox for retry and are not owner-deleted.
vectors.testName: retains inbox resources when a transient read fails

vectors.threat: An oversized container representation prevents processing even when valid children appear early.
vectors.expected: Incremental parsing survives split IRIs and dots in strings/comments, cancels after collecting a bounded batch, and does not read the oversized tail.
vectors.testName: cancels an adversarially chunked oversized container after a drainable batch

vectors.threat: A transient replay or relationship store outage quarantines and deletes a valid request.
vectors.expected: Untyped processor storage failures propagate for retry without quarantine.
vectors.testName: propagates transient processor storage failures without quarantine

vectors.threat: An authenticated identity floods relationship delivery or verification endpoints.
vectors.expected: Per-identity request budgets reject excess traffic and reset only after the configured window.
vectors.testName: relationship delivery route rate limits authenticated floods with Retry-After

vectors.threat: An authenticated recipient floods delivery-assertion verification.
vectors.expected: The verification endpoint enforces its own recipient-session budget and emits Retry-After.
vectors.testName: relationship verification route rate limits authenticated floods with Retry-After

vectors.threat: External WebID discovery reaches loopback, private, link-local, or cloud metadata addresses.
vectors.expected: Unsafe URLs and resolved addresses are rejected before an HTTP request is sent.
vectors.testName: parsePublicUrl rejects unsafe protocols, credentials, ports, and direct private hosts

vectors.threat: A public redirect or DNS answer pivots delivery to a private address.
vectors.expected: Every redirect target and resolved address is revalidated.
vectors.testName: fetchPublicResource revalidates redirect targets and blocks private DNS answers

vectors.threat: NodeZero bearer or caller-controlled authorization headers leak to an external origin.
vectors.expected: The public fetch contract exposes no authorization-header input and sends none.
vectors.testName: public request contract has no authorization or caller-controlled header input

vectors.threat: The same relationship activity mutates state more than once.
vectors.expected: A conditional per-activity reservation permits only one concurrent mutation across processors.
vectors.testName: allows only one concurrent processor to mutate the same activity

vectors.threat: A processor crashes after reserving an activity and permanently suppresses it.
vectors.expected: Expired reservations are read, deleted, and conditionally recreated exactly once.
vectors.testName: reclaims an expired replay reservation and retries conditional creation once

vectors.threat: A stale reclaimer deletes another processor's newly acquired replay reservation.
vectors.expected: Expired reservation deletion requires the stale ETag and fails closed when that ETag loses the race.
vectors.testName: does not delete a replacement reservation when stale reclamation loses the ETag race

vectors.threat: An authenticated attacker consumes another actor's known activity ID and suppresses the legitimate activity.
vectors.expected: Outbound IDs are session-Pod scoped and receiver replay keys reject a different verified actor.
vectors.testName: quarantines cross-actor replay-key collisions before relationship mutation

vectors.threat: A syntactically valid activity claims another WebID as actor.
vectors.expected: Only an exact verified actor reaches relationship processing; mismatches quarantine.
vectors.testName: processes only when the verifier returns the exact claimed actor

vectors.threat: A delivery assertion is replayed for another recipient or a modified payload.
vectors.expected: Recipient binding, payload digest, expiry, issuer, and signing key are verified.
vectors.testName: rejects tampering, a different recipient, expiry, and a foreign key

vectors.threat: Private relationship or moderation state is accidentally made publicly readable.
vectors.expected: Consent, outbox, quarantine, relationship, moderation, replay, and receipt ACLs remain owner-only.
vectors.testName: keeps outbox, quarantine, consent, relationship, and moderation containers owner-only

vectors.threat: Private-looking fields enter or remain on the public discovery manifest Thing.
vectors.expected: The object contract rejects undeclared fields and manifest writes delete stale unknown predicates from the canonical public Thing.
vectors.testName: removes stale unknown predicates from the public manifest Thing

vectors.threat: Legacy foaf:knows values are upgraded to accepted consent or duplicate relationship history.
vectors.expected: Legacy links import idempotently as legacy-connected without fabricated activity IDs.
vectors.testName: runs the complete legacy migration twice without fabricating acceptance history

vectors.threat: A blocked actor reaches replay checks or relationship mutation.
vectors.expected: Block evaluation occurs before replay lookup and relationship mutation.
vectors.testName: enforces block precedence before replay checks or relationship mutation

vectors.threat: An accepted or Trust Circle peer remains eligible for directed compose after being blocked.
vectors.expected: Block state removes the peer from every explicit compose audience.
vectors.testName: block precedence removes accepted Trust Circle members

vectors.threat: A client bypasses compose filtering and directly calls the relationship delivery endpoint for a blocked recipient.
vectors.expected: The server reads private owner moderation state and rejects before external discovery.
vectors.testName: relationship delivery route enforces the authenticated owner Pod block before discovery
